online.seatCountRule: max(2, min(4, humans)); one human fills to 2, two humans play 2, three or four humans use the table they brought
online.stateSync: HTTP polling, server-authoritative; dice are generated by the server engine and never submitted by clients

features.rooms: 4-seat room capacity; at start seatCount(humans) chooses 2–4 seats
features.invite: inviteUrl uses the request Host; opens /boardgame/aeroplane-premium/online.html?room=&code=
features.sync: stateVersion + lastAction; both clients receive the same public view (all plane positions + dice history)
features.aiFill: 1 human → 2 seats (1 AI); empty seats are played by the same engine AI
features.reconnect: session token + POST /api/rooms/:id/reconnect; reconnect clears takeover
features.timeoutTakeover: no session request for the idle timeout → server AI plays that seat
features.leaderboard: GET /api/leaderboard?game=aeroplane-premium; AI participants included; raw playerId hashed
features.idempotency: per-player idempotencyKey cached before the turn guard
features.serverDice: adapter.view/legalActions/applyAction call E.ensureRoll on the server; actions carrying dice are rejected with E_DICE
features.publicView: all plane positions and past dice are public; seed, rngState and future rolls are never serialised
